name: Hat Yai
registryAssessment: The official Department of Lands Songkhla Provincial Land Office identifies the Hat Yai branch and its Hat Yai district responsibility; the Ministry/Department of Lands LandsPublic viewer is an official public map channel. This establishes a real local cadastral custodian and public map service, but not open cadastral parcel-vector integration for this packet.

queries.query: Hat Yai Thailand official cadastral parcel map GIS land records Department of Lands
queries.result: Found the official Department of Lands LandsPublic viewer, the Department of Lands home page linking LandsMaps and land-record services, and the official Songkhla Provincial Land Office pages. The current viewer JavaScript exposed a public point-query route and GeoServer WFS/WMS routes. No safe cadastral parcel polygon/native parcel identity was returned.

officialSources.role: Department of Lands official LandsPublic viewer
officialSources.observation: Current public viewer fetched successfully. Its current JavaScript declares the point query https://portal.dol.go.th/api/nsldata/search-by-point?lat={lat}&lng={lng}, GeoServer WMS/WFS routes, and public-land layer DOLNSL; the viewer is not evidence that cadastral parcels are openly downloadable.

officialSources.role: Official Department of Lands GeoServer WFS capabilities
officialSources.observation: Anonymous capabilities returned HTTP 200 and EPSG:4326 feature types province, amphoe, tambol, DOL_Bound, and DOLNSL (public land). No cadastral parcel feature type was listed.

officialSources.role: Songkhla Provincial Land Office official contact/custodian page
officialSources.observation: Identifies the Songkhla Provincial Land Office and its official contact details. Search results and the official provincial site identify the Hat Yai branch.

officialSources.role: Songkhla Provincial Land Office official home page
officialSources.observation: Lists official services including parcel-shape search and public-land (NSL) lookup and identifies Hat Yai in the responsibility search context.

officialSources.role: Official Ministry of Interior / Department of Lands notice
officialSources.observation: Official notice states that Songkhla Provincial Land Office Hat Yai Branch has Hat Yai district in its operating responsibility for deed issuance, surveying, registration, and related real-property matters.

geometryDecision.reason: No safe native cadastral parcel ID plus full polygon was obtained from an anonymous public response. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted; a point-query no-data response and a zero-result public-land query do not establish citywide cadastral absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Department of Lands LandsPublic viewer/configuration, official GeoServer WMS/WFS capabilities, exact WUP point request, bounded public-land WFS request, and Songkhla/Hat Yai land-office custodian pages.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official service and local custodian provenance were verified. The exposed WFS is limited to administrative/public-land layers; cadastral parcel schema, native parcel identity, parcel CRS/geometry, exact-point containment, and citywide coverage were not verified.

safeFieldAllowlist: safe parcel/native ID only if publicly returned and non-personal
